facts.statement: Vescornis is a genus of extinct bird belonging to the Enantiornithes clade.
facts.quote: Vescornis is a genus of enantiornithine bird.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil of Vescornis is held at the Nanjing Institute of Geology and Paleontology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.
facts.quote: The holotype fossil is in the collection of the Nanjing Institute of Geology and Paleontology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

facts.statement: The genus Vescornis was formally described by Zhang and colleagues in 2004.
facts.quote: Vescornis was described in detail by Zhang et al. in 2004.

facts.statement: Fossils of Vescornis were found in Early Cretaceous rocks originally attributed to the Yixian Formation in Hebei Province, China.
facts.quote: The fossil was found in Early Cretaceous rocks first attributed to the Yixian Formation, Senjitu, Fengning County, Hebei Province, China.

facts.statement: Later geological studies reclassified the rock formation containing Vescornis fossils as the Huajiying Formation.
facts.quote: However, later study of area geology showed that these rocks actually belong to the Huajiying Formation.

facts.statement: Vescornis is classified within the family Gobipterygidae.
Vescornis lived during the Barremian to Aptian stages, approximately 125.77 to 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: It is debated whether Vescornis is a synonym of the genera Jibeinia or Hebeiornis.
facts.quote: The three taxa Jibeinia, Vescornis, and "Hebeiornis", may be synonyms.

facts.statement: There is no scientific consensus on the synonymy of Vescornis, Jibeinia, and Hebeiornis, with some researchers treating them as distinct species.
facts.quote: However, there is no consensus over whether or not they are actually synonyms, and some scientists continue to regard them as separate species.

facts.statement: Researchers conclude that verifying if Vescornis and Jibeinia are the same species is impossible without rediscovering the lost holotype of Jibeinia.
facts.quote: Thus they conclude that it will be impossible to verify whether the two are the same species, unless the holotype of Jibeinia is rediscovered.

facts.statement: Vescornis is an extinct genus of avialan belonging to the Enantiornithes clade.
facts.quote: Vescornis es un género extinto de avialano perteneciente al clado Enantiornithes.
